Thallikivandanam allocation
The promise of TDP alliance was that, the benefits under scheme Thallikivandanam, would be avaialable to every child. 

Amount shown as allocation to Thallikivandanam in Budget in brief is Rs. 9,668 crores. 

What is actually allocated is only Rs. 8,456 crores.   

What is required for implementation of scheme for 87,41,885 students is
Rs. 13,112 crores

text:
Allocation towards Dipam scheme
Considering the prevailing LPG price and number of beneficiaries under PM Ujwal Yojana, 

The amount of subsidy required under Dipam scheme for providing 3 free gas cylinders is Rs. 3,990.76 cores. 

Amount spent during FY 26 as per RE is ony Rs. 2,199,99 crores. 

However, allocation under the budget for FY 27 is only Rs. 2,601 cores. 

Owing to this under-allocation, nearly 47 lakh households will be left out of Dipam scheme
Source – Budget documents & PPAC, MOPNG
